angles: Purpose Mismatch: Temporal is a general-purpose durable execution platform; LangGraph is purpose-built for AI agent orchestration — the right choice depends on whether your primary need is reliability or AI-native abstractions
Composability: These are complementary, not competitive — use LangGraph for agent orchestration logic and wrap it in Temporal workflows for durable execution, persistence, and fault tolerance

Production Readiness: Temporal offers enterprise-grade durability with 20K+ GitHub stars, managed cloud ($1K free credits), and SDKs in 6 languages; LangGraph offers graph-based state machines with checkpointing but less battle-tested for extreme production scenarios

Developer Experience: LangGraph requires learning graph theory and state machines (120+ lines for a ReAct agent); Temporal requires understanding workflow/activity patterns and deterministic replay constraints
Abstraction Level: Temporal operates at workflow/activity granularity (microservices-level), LangGraph operates at agent/node/tool granularity (LLM-native) — pick based on where you need control
Ecosystem Lock-in: LangGraph is deeply integrated with LangChain ecosystem; Temporal is framework-agnostic and can orchestrate any agent system
